newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PX50 DROPS BUT RADIOKOMUNIKACE RACES AHEAD.
newsitem.headline: CZECH PX50 DROPS BUT RADIOKOMUNIKACE RACES AHEAD.

text.p: The Czech PX50 lost ground on Thursday as the three most heavily capitalised shares, accounting for 45 percent of total index capitalisation, all posted losses.
SPT Telecom led the way with an 89 crown fall to 4,301. CEZ dropped 10 crowns to 938 and Komercni Banka lost 19 crowns to 2,026.

Radio transmission company Ceske Radiokomunikace continued to surge adding the maximum daily allowed five percent to hit 4,400 at the fixing. TeleDanmark said on Tuesday it had taken a 21 percent stake in the Czech company.
Analysts and dealers said that the TeleDanmark purchase was good news for Radiokomunikace's long term prospects but noted that very few shares now remained on the open market.
The state owns 70 percent of Radiokomunikace's shares.
